purpose: Source-bound extraction review. This is neither production acceptance nor an independent historical adjudication.
checks: All immutable downloaded source body hashes match manifest.
All suggested entity ids are actual production entities.
All source dates parse as valid day-precision dates and retain real tenure endpoints.
Canada 18 ministries and Japan 59 cabinets through 1960 extracted; split strong-tag Bowell surname regression checked.
Victoria full premier table uses Assumed office / Left office columns, with six-column guard.
Queensland list source uses DD/MM/YYYY; full given names retained.
NSW card boundaries tested against first Donaldson card so current-office name cannot bleed into history.

sourceSemantics.japan-cabinets: Each his-block is a numbered cabinet term. Adjacent same-person terms are often a continuous Prime Minister tenure; do not count cabinet reappointments as distinct new persons or claim improvements if existing tenure covers them. Official English spelling HATOYMA is present in body; preserve original label as evidence, reconcile display spelling separately.
sourceSemantics.c01-canada-ministry-tenures: Intro explicitly defines ministry by prime minister tenure, oath to resignation/death/dismissal. Date columns are DD-MM-YYYY. Historical transfer gaps shown by body are preserved; do not interpolate to successors.
sourceSemantics.bulk01-victoria-premiers: Table explicitly says Premier leader with Legislative Assembly support. Assumed office and Left office full dates are explicit. Roman reappointment suffix stripped from person but retained in originalRow. Pre-1902 blank party cells not filled.
sourceSemantics.bulk01-queensland-premiers: Government official named-office list of former Premiers. Source first Herbert term begins 1859-12-10 whereas parliamentary list found during discovery begins 1860-05-22: hold that pre-snapshot row; do not reconcile automatically.
sourceSemantics.bulk01-nsw-premiers: Government served-as-premier cards give real full dates; end dates sometimes precede next start by one day and sometimes equal next start. Preserve endpoints; automatic exclusive/inclusive normalization unsafe.
